corpusFilter.excludedReason: Skill docs, worked examples, API references, repo metadata and superseded versions are not system prompts. Auditing them would inflate every finding, because example code is full of the patterns we detect.

ruleScope.excludedReason: These rules need request-level or runtime context that extracted prompt text does not contain. Including them would report dataset artefacts, not prompt properties.

rulesByFrequency.title: A timestamp is inside the cached prefix

example.snippet: Today's date: Monday, August 10, 2026 (for more granularity, use bash)

rulesByFrequency.title: Prefix is below the provider minimum, so caching is silently skipped

example.snippet: 894 estimated tokens vs. 1,024 minimum for Anthropic Claude

rulesByFrequency.title: The cached prefix is far larger than it needs to be

example.snippet: prefix is ~78,151 tokens; above ~32,000 every call re-reads it
